title: Hermit server — composition root design (port of Jellyfin.Server / Program.cs + Startup.cs + ApplicationHost.InitializeServices)
goal: Wire the 33 hermit-api AppState manager trait objects (+ the transcode chain) from the concrete hermit-core / Wave-5 impls, load config, open+migrate the SQLite DB, discover ffmpeg, build a NEW StreamStatePlanner to make playback LIVE via .with_media_encoding, seed a fresh-install admin, mount hermit_api::create_router, and serve on axum.

source_refs.transcode_seam_design: .port/transcode/design.json  (SegmentTranscoder / TranscodeManagerImpl::start_ffmpeg / RunningJob already designed; StreamStatePlanner left as the un-ported seam)
source_refs.jellyfin_bootstrap: 3rdparty/jellyfin Jellyfin.Server/Program.cs (CreateApplicationPaths -> InitLogging -> PerformStaticInitialization -> appHost.Init -> InitializeServices -> Kestrel), ApplicationHost.cs:645 InitializeServices
source_refs.jellyfin_ffmpeg: 3rdparty/jellyfin MediaBrowser.MediaEncoding/Encoder/MediaEncoder.cs:180 SetFFmpegPath (CLI/env -> config EncoderAppPath -> "ffmpeg" on PATH -> EncoderValidator -version -> derive ffprobe by regex)

construction_dag.note: Dependency-ordered. Each entry: manager(AppState field or infra) -> concrete impl -> ::new signature -> what it depends on. Build strictly top-to-bottom; every Arc<dyn> a later ctor needs is already built above it. All ctors are sync unless marked async. There are NO cycles (verified: session<-user/device/user-data/library/dto/event; dto<-library/user-data/counts/image/media-sources/chapters/trickplay/providers; media-sources<-encoder/providers; none point back up).

config_shape.precedence: CLI (clap) > env HERMIT_* > config.toml > built-in defaults. Loaded with the `config` crate; env prefix HERMIT_, `__` as the nested separator.

fields.notes: Root program-data dir. Derives: {data_dir}/data (db + library.db), {data_dir}/root, {data_dir}/metadata, {data_dir}/cache, {data_dir}/log, {data_dir}/config. Feeds HermitServerApplicationPaths::new.
Static web client path (ServeDir); optional for First-Light API-only bring-up.

fields.magic_number_flag: 8096 is Jellyfin's default HTTP port — expose as this setting (Jellyfin parity), range 1..65535.
8920 is Jellyfin's default HTTPS port; only used when tls enabled (TLS deferred for First-Light). Surfaced for parity.

fields.notes: Explicit ffmpeg binary; else config EncoderAppPath; else `ffmpeg` on PATH (see ffmpeg_discovery).
Explicit ffprobe; else derived from ffmpeg_path by basename regex (jellyfin parity).
Initial media library root folders; used by fresh-install seeding to create virtual folders + trigger the first scan. Empty = admin adds via API.

config_shape.config_toml_note: config.toml is OPTIONAL; a missing file is not an error (defaults + env only). Distinct from hermit's own runtime system.json which HermitServerConfigurationManager owns — config.toml is bootstrap-only (where to find data_dir/ffmpeg/bind), system.json is the running server configuration.

ffmpeg_discovery: Port of MediaEncoder.SetFFmpegPath. discover_ffmpeg(config) -> anyhow::Result<(String,String)>: (1) candidate = config.ffmpeg_path (from --ffmpeg / HERMIT_FFMPEG_PATH); (2) else config system.json EncoderAppPath (HermitServerConfigurationManager encoding options); (3) else "ffmpeg" resolved on $PATH (which::which). Validate: run `<candidate> -version`, require exit 0 and stdout starts with 'ffmpeg version' (EncoderValidator parity — full decoder/encoder/hwaccel enumeration deferred; a -version smoke check is enough for First-Light). Derive ffprobe: config.ffprobe_path if set, else regex-replace the ffmpeg basename `ffmpeg` -> `ffprobe` (FfprobePathRegex parity), then `<ffprobe> -version` validate. On failure: log the tried method and return Err so startup aborts loudly (playback would 500 otherwise). Persist the resolved path back into system.json EncoderAppPathDisplay (jellyfin parity, optional).

streamstate_planner_plan.what_it_is: The last un-ported slice: hermit_hls::StreamStatePlanner is an existing trait (crates/hermit-hls/src/hls_stream_manager.rs:89) with ONE method `async fn plan(&self, request: &HlsStreamRequest, is_audio: bool, segment_id: Option<i32>) -> Result<TranscodePlan, ServiceError>`. Everything ABOVE it (playlist gen, segment start/reuse via TranscodeManagerImpl::start_ffmpeg, path-traversal guard, kill) is already ported + unit-tested against a FakePlanner. The concrete impl is the composition-root's job — it is Jellyfin's StreamingHelpers.GetStreamingState + EncodingHelper.GetCommandLineArguments (the ~last large port), deliberately left behind the seam so the orchestration stays testable.
streamstate_planner_plan.where_it_lives: NEW type `HermitStreamStatePlanner` in a new module apps/hermit-server/src/planner.rs (or a tiny crates/hermit-streamstate crate if it needs its own unit tests — recommended: keep it in hermit-server for First-Light; promote to a crate once it grows, since it depends on hermit-core MediaSourceManager + hermit-mediaencoding EncodingHelper + hermit-model DTOs, which are all already workspace deps of hermit-server). It implements hermit_hls::StreamStatePlanner.
streamstate_planner_plan.output_it_must_build: TranscodePlan { state: EncodingJobInfo, playlist_path: PathBuf, arguments: Vec<String>, media_path: String, run_time_ticks: i64, segment_length_ms: i32, is_remuxing_video: bool, segment_container: String }. The `state` is handed straight to TranscodeManagerImpl::start_ffmpeg; `arguments` is the fully-built ffmpeg command line.
constructor_deps: media_sources: Arc<dyn MediaSourceManager> — resolve the item's MediaSourceInfo (GetStreamingState step 1: get media source + streams for HlsStreamRequest.item_id/media_source_id).
encoder: Arc<dyn MediaEncoder> — encoder_path() for the program + capability queries (thread count, supported encoders).

encoding_helper: EncodingHelper<NoOptionalEncoders> — the ported piecewise arg builders (video_encoder/audio_encoder/map_args/video_bitrate_param/audio_bitrate_param/number_of_threads/video_quality_param/framerate_param/can_stream_copy_video/can_stream_copy_audio). NoOptionalEncoders = stock software ffmpeg (aac/libx264); the real capability probe is deferred.
config: Arc<dyn ServerConfigurationManager> — EncodingOptions (segment length default, transcode temp path) + GetTranscodePath.
paths: Arc<HermitServerApplicationPaths> — the segment cache dir + deterministic output-file id (GetSegmentPath / output hash).
plan_algorithm: 1. RESOLVE MEDIA SOURCE (GetStreamingState): media_sources.get_media_source(item_id, media_source_id) -> MediaSourceInfo; pick default/best video + audio + (requested) subtitle MediaStream. Fill run_time_ticks, container, media_path.

2. DECIDE DIRECT-PLAY vs TRANSCODE per stream: use EncodingHelper::can_stream_copy_video / can_stream_copy_audio against the request's target codecs/bitrate/container. is_remuxing_video = is_copy_codec(output_video_codec). For First-Light: honor the request's declared supported codecs; when copy is possible, copy (remux) — cheapest correct path.

3. POPULATE EncodingJobInfo (transcode_state shape): base_request from HlsStreamRequest (BaseEncodingJobOptions), video_stream/audio_stream/subtitle_stream (the picked MediaStreams), media_source, output_video_codec/output_audio_codec (from request or copy), output_*_bitrate/channels, output_container = segment_container, output_file_path = {transcode_root}/{output_id}.m3u8, is_input_video, subtitle_delivery_method, run_time_ticks, transcoding_type = TranscodingJobType::Hls, segment_length_secs (from EncodingOptions, default 6), wait_for_path = GetSegmentPath(output_id, segment_id.unwrap_or(0)), segment_container, play_session_id + device_id (from request). The output_id is the deterministic StreamingHelpers hash so a re-request reuses the same dir/playlist.

4. BUILD FFMPEG ARGS (GetCommandLineArguments — the NEW top-level orchestrator this planner adds, composing the ported piecewise EncodingHelper methods): input args (-ss seek for segment_id, -i media_path, analyzeduration/probesize), map_args (stream selection), video: `-c:v` video_encoder(state) [or `copy` when is_remuxing_video] + video_bitrate_param + video_quality_param + framerate_param + `-threads` number_of_threads, audio: `-c:a` audio_encoder(state) + audio_bitrate_param + channels, subtitle burn-in only if SubtitleDeliveryMethod::Encode, then HLS muxer args: `-f hls -hls_time {segment_length} -hls_playlist_type vod -hls_segment_type (mpegts|fmp4) -hls_segment_filename {dir}/{id}%d.{ext} -hls_list_size 0 {playlist_path}`. Return the Vec<String>.
5. RETURN TranscodePlan { state, playlist_path, arguments, media_path, run_time_ticks, segment_length_ms = segment_length_secs*1000, is_remuxing_video, segment_container }.
deferred_within_planner: Hardware acceleration matrix (nvenc/qsv/vaapi/videotoolbox) — NoOptionalEncoders software path only.
Full direct-stream/transcode-reason decision tree — First-Light: request-declared codecs decide copy-vs-encode.
Subtitle provider fan-out; only stored/embedded subtitle burn-in via SubtitleDeliveryMethod::Encode.
streamstate_planner_plan.why_seam_not_inline: RULES_CODE_REUSE: HlsStreamManagerImpl lives in hermit-hls (the only crate depending on BOTH the playlist generator and the transcode manager). The planner depends on hermit-core (MediaSourceManager) which hermit-hls must NOT depend on, so the join is inverted through the StreamStatePlanner trait and supplied at the composition root. Keeps hermit-hls's dependency graph clean and the orchestration unit-testable with FakePlanner.

fresh_install_admin_seeding.trigger: After DB migrate + config load, in the InitializeServices-equivalent step: users.get_all()/count. If ZERO users exist -> fresh install.
fresh_install_admin_seeding.jellyfin_parity: Emby ApplicationHost / UserManager first-run: creates the initial admin during the setup wizard. Hermit seeds it directly (no wizard for First-Light).
steps: 1. If no users: create a default admin user via HermitUserManager (name from HERMIT_ADMIN_USER or 'admin'; password from HERMIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD or empty-then-must-change). Grant is_administrator policy.
2. Ensure a stable server_id/system_id: read from system.json; if absent, generate a UUID and persist (feeds SystemHostFacts.system_id, dto server_id, auth_context system_id).

3. For each config.library_roots entry: create a virtual folder / library root via LibraryManager and enqueue an initial scan (scan itself may be a manual run-now task for First-Light since HermitTaskManager has no cron loop).
4. Idempotent: on subsequent boots users already exist -> skip seeding; server_id is reused.

settings_flagged.as_setting: HERMIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD — exposed; empty default is a deliberate 'set on first login' posture, worth confirming with the user

bootstrap_sequence: 1. parse CLI (clap) + build layered config (config crate: defaults <- config.toml <- env HERMIT_* <- CLI).
2. init tracing-subscriber (EnvFilter from log_level).  [Jellyfin: InitLoggingConfigFile + InitializeLoggingFramework]
3. build HermitServerApplicationPaths from config; create_dir_all the derived dirs.  [CreateApplicationPaths]
7. construct managers in construction_dag tier order (0..8).
9. fresh-install admin seeding (if no users) + library roots.
11. router = hermit_api::create_router(state); (optionally nest ServeDir for web_dir).
12. axum::serve(bind_addr:port, router).with_graceful_shutdown(shutdown wired to HermitLifecycleController).await.  [Kestrel StartServer]

first_light_integration_test_plan.location: apps/hermit-server/tests/first_light.rs (integration dir — NOT part of the unit-coverage gate).
first_light_integration_test_plan.ffmpeg_gating: Playback tests guard on HERMIT_FFMPEG_TESTS env + which('ffmpeg')/which('ffprobe'); absent-ffmpeg CI stays green (mirrors .port/transcode/design.json part5 gating).
first_light_integration_test_plan.harness: A `spawn_test_server()` helper: tempdir data_dir, HERMIT_DATA_DIR + ephemeral port (bind 127.0.0.1:0), run the real bootstrap, return (base_url, admin_token, JoinHandle). Uses reqwest against the live axum server.
cases: 1. BOOT: server starts, GET /System/Info/Public returns 200 with server_id + version (proves AppState wired + create_router mounted).
2. FRESH-INSTALL SEED: on a blank data_dir, an admin user exists; GET /Users returns exactly the seeded admin; a second boot does not duplicate it (idempotent).

3. AUTH: POST /Users/AuthenticateByName with the seeded admin returns an access token; a protected route (GET /System/Configuration) 401s without it and 200s with it (auth_context + auth_service wired).

4. LIBRARY -> ITEM: add a virtual folder pointing at a fixture dir with one tiny media file; run the scan task (run-now); GET /Items?... returns the item with a MediaSource (library + media_sources + dto + repos wired).
5. PLAYBACK INFO: POST /Items/{id}/PlaybackInfo returns a MediaSource + play_session_id (media_sources manager).

6. [ffmpeg-gated] HLS LIVE: using a real generated fixture clip (ffmpeg testsrc, as in transcode design), GET the HLS master playlist for the item -> 200 + '#EXTM3U'; GET the variant playlist -> contains >=1 #EXTINF; GET the first segment -> non-empty ts/mp4 body. This exercises the FULL path: HermitStreamStatePlanner.plan -> args -> TranscodeManagerImpl::start_ffmpeg -> TokioSegmentTranscoder spawn -> segment file served. This is the First-Light 'playback is LIVE' proof.
7. [ffmpeg-gated] STOP: DELETE/stop the active encoding -> subsequent segment request 404/kills cleanly (kill path).
8. SHUTDOWN: graceful shutdown signal terminates serve without panic (HermitLifecycleController wired).
first_light_integration_test_plan.coverage_carveout: The real ffmpeg-spawn planner path is integration-only + env-gated; hermit-server's own unit tests cover config layering, ffmpeg discovery (with a fake `which` + a stub `-version` script), the DAG assembly against in-memory DB, and admin seeding idempotency.
